name: run-hosted-morphic-runtime
problem_solved: execute one bounded deterministic target-neutral Morphic core through hosted, fake, and freestanding RISC-V execution boundaries
selection_reasons: The resource planner derives fixed storage and initialization order.
The scheduler owns target-neutral time and runnable ordering policy.
The event trace records normalized bounded behavior.

The existing physical-region and page-frame modules turn only the eight-page linker-reserved interval into deterministic owned frames; address types and PFN conversion preserve domain and alignment truth.
The freestanding-only owner adapter binds the existing generic Sv39 builder, entry, indexing, walker, and SFENCE.VMA semantics to page-table frames allocated from the linker-owned physical pool.
The bounded ELF planner remains the sole process-image policy authority for both the preserved one-segment Batch 22B fixture and the distinct Batch 23 R-X plus initialized RW-/BSS fixture.

The Batch 26 machine exec adapter consumes project 59 MaterializedImage pages generically, stages exact bytes in already-reserved physical backing, and installs final Sv39 permissions only after complete preparation.
inherited_guarantees: Fixed resource derivation, stable runnable ordering, caller-controlled time, bounded trace storage, and explicit capacity failures.

One shared core owns planning, scheduling, tracing, and output formatting; hosted and fake machines provide bounded task output, while the freestanding RISC-V adapter adds entry, stack, transport, shutdown, and panic behavior plus one bounded resumable S-mode breakpoint trap, one bounded asynchronous supervisor timer interrupt, and a separate four-tick bounded monotonic supervisor timer phase around the same shared execution path. A small freestanding-only adapter consumes the four recorded rdtime observations through BoundedDeterministicScheduler.advanceTo after all corresponding sret returns and records bounded readiness/order evidence.

The synchronous breakpoint alone advances sepc by its ELF-proven 32-bit instruction width. Timer interrupts leave sepc unchanged. The one-shot masks STIE and sets the deadline to maximum; each non-final repeated tick re-arms from newly observed time plus 100000 counter units, and the fourth tick masks STIE and sets the deadline to maximum before sret.

Scheduler-facing machine time uses the raw RV64 rdtime value as u64 through an identity mapping, so the bridge performs no narrowing or arithmetic; advanceTo retains the scheduler time-reversal rejection and ordering semantics.

The freestanding adapter reserves one eight-page, 4096-byte-aligned NOLOAD pool in its ELF, reads the linker bounds and actual satp CSR, registers exactly that interval as usable, and exercises the existing allocator. Direct access is valid only for the mechanically observed Bare mode; this is neither platform RAM discovery nor a production PMM, and Sv39 remains inactive during that preserved phase; Batch 17 activates it only afterward.

After the preserved Batch 17 broad-RWX activation frame, Builder.protect directly replaces every live 4 KiB leaf without a transient unmap while preserving physical targets and levels. ELF-derived page-aligned domains then provide supervisor text RX/A, rodata R/A/NX, writable image/stack/pool and translated alias RW/A/D/NX; one global SFENCE.VMA precedes positive probes and the unchanged Morphic workload. The freestanding RealPageOwner supplies actual machine page-table frames; riscv-page-table-page-owner remains the reusable hosted semantic precedent and is not the machine provider.

Batch 26 exec PREPARE now completes both neutral main/interpreter MaterializedImage values and verifies sufficient pre-existing backing before COMMIT; COMMIT performs no allocation and installs every prepared page with translated final U-mode permissions, followed by SFENCE.VMA and FENCE.I.

Static executable orchestration preserves a null interpreter: PREPARE does not resolve an interpreter, materializes only the main image, omits AT_BASE, and commits the unbiased main entry; PT_INTERP images still resolve and prepare their exact declared interpreter.
gaps_discovered: The hosted path still relies on Linux userspace. The freestanding riscv64 path proves one fixed-frame resumable synchronous breakpoint trap, one one-shot supervisor timer interrupt, one finite four-delivery monotonic repeated-tick phase, and non-preemptive scheduler decisions driven by those observations after sret; indefinite periodic ticking, timekeeping accuracy, preemption, sleeping tasks, clock accuracy, nested traps/interrupts, multiple harts, floating-point/vector context, hardware discovery, and Linux/POSIX/Alpine compatibility remain out of scope or unimplemented.

Physical-memory ownership remains limited to the linker-reserved eight-page pool, and the hardened map remains one bounded supervisor address space. No DTB/RAM discovery, U-mode, page-fault recovery, per-process mappings, ASIDs, demand paging, SMP shootdown, general allocator policy, or general VMM is claimed.
future_systems_enabled: later bounded scheduler-facing time-source and machine-boundary work without preemption
later non-preemptive timeout orchestration using an explicitly declared counter-unit policy
later active-Sv39 work using explicitly owned frames rather than guessed platform RAM
later bounded U-mode entry work built on a supervisor-only W^X kernel baseline
